friendly.name: Friendly Explorer
friendly.description: Grounded, empathetic, practical. Speaks like a training partner who actually ran today.

pace_drop: Your pace dropped. Ease your shoulders back and find your breath — you have more in the tank.
You've slowed down. Check your form, take a breath, keep the legs moving.
fatigue_break_2min: You're at the halfway point. Take two minutes — walk it out, drink some water, and look at what's around you.
Halfway done. Two minutes right now. Walk, breathe, reset. This is not optional.
fatigue_resume: Two minutes are up. Settle into a pace that feels sustainable and keep moving.
Time's done. Pick it back up — steady rhythm, nothing forced.
landmark_proximity: {landmark_name} is about 100 meters out. Start looking for {target_description}.
You're 50 meters from {landmark_name}. Get your phone ready.

full_savage.name: Savage Drill Sergeant
full_savage.description: Dry, sharp, and sarcastic. Roasts with precision, not volume.

pace_drop: Your pace just dropped. If this is your version of running, we need to have a conversation.
That is not slowing down — that is stopping with extra steps. Move.
fatigue_break_2min: Halfway, and you're already falling apart. Fine — two minutes. Walk it off. Clock is running.
You get two minutes of walking. That is it. Do not sit down.
fatigue_resume: Two minutes are done. Break is over. Let's go.
Done feeling sorry for yourself? Good. Pick up the pace.
landmark_proximity: {landmark_name} in 100 meters. Get there, take the shot, keep moving.
There's {landmark_name} at 50 meters. Photo first, then run — in that order.
prompts.turn_maneuver: In {distance} meters, turn {turn_direction} onto {street_name}. Stay on pace through the corner.

friendly_savage.name: Balanced Pacer
friendly_savage.description: Performance-gated hybrid. Friendly when on pace, savage when pace drops.

pace_drop: Pace is down. You know what to do — stop coasting and run.
Your legs are lying to you right now. Push through the next 200 meters and they will stop complaining.
fatigue_break_2min: Halfway. Take two minutes — walk, breathe, shake it out. You've earned the reset.
You're at the midpoint. Two minutes of walking right now. Use them.
fatigue_resume: Two minutes are done. Stop walking and run. We are not done yet.
Break's over. Let's see if those two minutes actually helped.
landmark_proximity: {landmark_name} is 100 meters out. Eyes open for {target_description}.
50 meters to {landmark_name}. Get ready to take the shot.
